channel.title: SignalFx US0 incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from SignalFx US0's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Datapoints Being Dropped [resolved]
item.description:
Between 7:37 PM and 8:17 PM PST, a small number of data points for new time series were not accepted. As a result, new time series may have experienced a delay of approximately 20–25 minutes before becoming available in charting and detectors.
APM and RUM ingestion were not impacted.

item.description: Some customers may have experienced delays in alert notifications from 4 am ~ 6 am (PST), July 24th, 2026. Datapoint ingest is not affected. The issue is recovered.

GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics not fetched in US0 [resolved]
item.description: Between 1a PDT and 2:50a PDT, any GCP integration that had the "Sync all (dynamically) listed projects" setting enabled had some of the Cloud Monitoring data from GCP dropped. This issue has been resolved. Customers may see gaps in charts and detectors that use affected GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics. AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor metrics are not impacted.

item.title: APM Trace Search and RUM Session Details Unavailable [resolved]
Detectors Delayed [resolved]
item.description:
The issue causing delays in some detectors has been resolved. Systems have recovered, and detector processing has returned to expected levels.
Thank you for your patience while we worked to resolve this issue.

item.title: Splunk APM Monitoring MetricSets delayed [resolved]
A partial outage of Splunk APM Tag Spotlight [resolved]
item.description: We have confirmed that the issue affecting Tag Spotlight has been resolved. Customers may have experienced limited functionality within Tag Spotlight beginning at approximately 4:30 PM PT on June 30. Full functionality was restored at 7:20 AM PT on July 1.

item.title: Logs correlation experience from a APM TraceView page was broken. [resolved]
item.description:
Due to a regression in a recent release, users navigating from Logs Related Content on the APM TraceView page to Log Observer were redirected back to APM TraceView instead. This impacted the Logs Correlation experience for customers across all realms, except US3 and Gov.
The change has been reverted to restore the expected navigation experience. Product availability for APM and Log Observer was not impacted; the issue was limited to the Logs Correlation workflow from TraceView.
Incident Start Time: 05:09 PDT, June 25, 2026 Incident End Time: 22:15 PDT, June 25, 2026

item.title: O11y APM Trace Lookups failing between approximately 6/17 5:30am PT - 7:30am PT [resolved]
item.description:
The fix has been successfully deployed, and we have confirmed that the issue affecting Trace Lookup searchability for traces generated between approximately 5:30 AM and 7:30 AM PT on June 17 has been resolved.
Customers should now be able to search affected traces as expected.
